description.en:
BenchCouncil lists SignalP 6.0 in the AI4Science area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “SignalP 6.0 predicts all five types of signal peptides using protein language models”. The page names Felix Teufel, Henrik Nielsen as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
